scenario: LCYC.7.2 — `cooldown` modifies firing rate but doesn't break a static rule-graph cycle. Even with a long cooldown (`cooldown 1h`), the emit-edge between two rules forms a cycle in the graph; the detector rejects. Pin: cooldown is a rate-shaping tool, not a cycle-breaker (LCYC.7 is the umbrella that LCYC doesn't close the door on TTL- or cooldown-paced cycles at runtime, but compile-time rejects regardless).
rules_ds:
schema X scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Y scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule a cooldown 1h:
    X
->
    emit Y logical v: 1

rule b cooldown 1h:
    Y
->
    emit X logical v: 1
